Construct · SM +3 Greater Stone Golem (Enraged Eggplant; answers SRD 3.5)

The same faceless basalt guardian built on an architectural scale, tall enough to reach a second storey, with layered armour ridges cut into it. Everything true of the smaller kind is true of this one, and there is a great deal more of it.

See review/policy/description-policy.md.
